A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we provide a consistent framework for the description of the non-forward matrix element in the pion, and the nucleon, in terms of skewed distributions, and we provide an effective theory for the computation of skewed distributions at a low normalization scale.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the skewed distribution is a more natural object to study than the double distribution, which can be reconstructed only in a model dependent way.
the skewed distribution is a more fundamental object than the distribution amplitude, and it can be measured in a number of reactions.
